definitions.gloss: hitting the mark; direct hit; striking the target
definitions.explanation: Successfully hitting a target with a projectile, shot, or thrown object. Also used figuratively for predictions or guesses that turn out to be correct.

examples.japanese: {弾|たま}が{的|まと}に{命中|めいちゅう}した。
{命中|めいちゅう}{率|りつ}が{高|たか}い。
{彼|かれ}の{予想|よそう}はみごとに{命中|めいちゅう}して、{試合|しあい}は{予測|よそく}{通|どお}りの{結果|けっか}になった。
examples.english: His prediction was spot on, and the game ended exactly as he had predicted.

notes: Common collocations: {命中|めいちゅう}する (to hit the mark), {命中|めいちゅう}{率|りつ} (accuracy rate, hit rate), {命中|めいちゅう}{精度|せいど} (accuracy). The figurative use for predictions ({予想|よそう}が{命中|めいちゅう}する) is also common. Often seen in military, sports (especially archery and shooting), and gaming contexts.
